content:
sarah (PM): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners for the three remediation items, Jira links, and handoff timelines. Recurrence pattern points to cache eviction + rollout fallback gaps. Goal: have owners and tickets by EOW. Reply with ticket or :thumbsup: to accept.

chris (SRE): I'll own 'cache eviction: stabilize LRU behavior' — will attach a Jira.

chris (SRE): JIRA: RED-4521 — planning/estimate in description. ETA: 2026-04-03. @alicia can you review the rollout plan?

alicia (Infra): I'll take 'deploy rollback path + graceful fallback' owner. Need a 30m handoff with oncall to walk runbook. Creating RED-4522 now.

ben (Monitoring): I can take 'alerts tuning + anomaly detection' — will prototype thresholds and add to RED-4523. Please make me owner for monitoring changes.

sarah (PM): RACI for the three items (high level): R=chris (cache), A=sarah (PM oversight), C=alicia (deploy), I=oncall. For deploy fallback, cross-team test required — @chris coordinate infra + oncall.

chris (SRE): ack. Scheduling infra + oncall test for Tue next week. Proposed: 2026-04-02 10:00 PST.

alicia (Infra): @oncall-bot can you confirm availability for that slot? I'll send a calendar invite once confirmed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary run for RED-4522 on 2026-04-02 10:00 PST. Link: https://jira.redwood/RED-4522

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: available — adding rota note and will join the test.

ben (Monitoring): :thumbsup: I'll add dashboard panels and alerts. Need a quick grant to view infra metrics (prometheus). @infra-team please add write/readonly as needed.

sarah (PM): Using this thread as single source of truth for owners. When you have the Jira links, paste them here and mark the postmortem doc as 'actions in progress'. Weekly check-ins until closed.

alicia (Infra): Handoff checklist I'll cover in the meeting. Pre-checklist snippet: ```pre-checks: runbook available, smoke tests defined, rollback commands validated
rollback: ./scripts/rollback.sh --to stable
smoke: ./scripts/smoke_check.sh```

chris (SRE): FYI found potential recurring cause — KV cache spike correlated with rollouts. Sample debug command: ```tail -n 200 /var/log/kv/cache.log | grep -i oom``` — I'll attach logs to RED-4521.

sarah (PM): Thanks — next check-in 2026-03-31 EOD from me. If anyone is blocked before then, ping me or drop updates here.

ben (Monitoring): Added RED-4523 link: https://jira.redwood/RED-4523 — prototype thresholds PR will be up by tomorrow.

chris (SRE): RED-4521 link: https://jira.redwood/RED-4521 — I've added acceptance criteria and a rollout plan.

alicia (Infra): RED-4522 link: https://jira.redwood/RED-4522 — invite sent to infra, oncall, and chris. See meeting notes in the calendar event.

sarah (PM): Great, everyone. I'll update the postmortem document to reflect assignees and Jira links. Keeping weekly status until all actions are closed. :white_check_mark:
